summary.text: Matt Birong, a Democrat from Vergennes, has represented Addison-3 in the Vermont House of Representatives since 2019.
He chairs the House Committee on Government Operations and Military Affairs.

paragraphs.text: Birong was born in Burlington, raised in Essex, and graduated from the New England Culinary Institute with a degree in Culinary Arts, according to his House biography.
He worked in fine dining establishments in Manhattan, Boston and Burlington over a career of more than twenty years.
Since 2007 he has been the chef and owner of 3 Squares Café in downtown Vergennes.
He was a member of the Vermont delegation to the 2016 Democratic National Convention and was named a Rising Star in Vermont Business Magazine's 40 under 40 that year.
In the House he also co-chairs the Canvassing Committee and is clerk of the Joint Public Pension Oversight Committee.
